displayName: LDA Topic Relationships · Jensen–Shannon Mutual kNN v1
description: An experimental passage-relationship graph that compares ten-topic LDA probability mixtures with Jensen–Shannon distance and retains only relationships that appear in both passages' ten nearest-neighbor lists.
calculation: The generator normalized each valid ten-topic vector, calculated base-2 Jensen–Shannon distance with the square root applied for all 4,546,620 passage pairs, ranked exact neighbors by ascending distance with passage ID as the deterministic tie-breaker, retained mutual 10-nearest-neighbor pairs, and stored each undirected pair once. No maximum-distance cutoff or minimum-degree rescue was applied. Existing DrL coordinates were held constant to isolate the effect of changing the relationship calculation.

representation.description: Each passage is represented by the normalized ten-topic probability mixture exported from the live legacy Gensim collection.

layout.distanceMeaning: The x/y coordinates are the existing DrL coordinates held constant for controlled comparison; screen distance is not the Jensen–Shannon relationship distance.
